## Summary of Changes
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance optimization

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation where needed
- [ ] My changes pass all existing backend tests (`pytest`)
- [ ] My changes pass frontend build (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Any new dependencies are documented in `requirements.txt` or `package.json`
